news.title: Renewed U.S.-Iran tensions in the Strait of Hormuz
news.summary: Two oil tankers, one Saudi-owned and one South Korean-owned, were hit overnight in the Strait of Hormuz, a fresh escalation that sent oil higher and equity futures broadly lower into Tuesday's session.

news.title: Futures red across the board on the Hormuz escalation
news.summary: S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow, and Russell 2000 futures all traded lower premarket as the shipping-route risk weighed on broad risk appetite.

news.title: Energy and commodity names outperforming premarket
news.summary: Names tied to oil and gas production traded higher premarket as crude climbed on the Strait of Hormuz risk, bucking the broader red tape.

news.title: Bitcoin and Ether soften overnight, proxy basket underperforms spot
news.summary: BTC and ETH both traded modestly lower overnight, roughly 1-1.6% off their prior close. The broader crypto-proxy basket fell further than spot, a real divergence forming as the session opens.

news.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI due today
news.summary: The week's first scheduled economic print lands this morning, with JOLTs, ADP, and Nonfarm Payrolls still ahead later in the week.

news.title: Markets still digesting Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole remarks
news.summary: The 10-year yield continues to hold near 4.78%, largely unchanged since Friday's address describing financial conditions as not broadly restrictive.
